items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I finally met a bassist named Emmanuel Jude whom I had known for a couple of years.

ctx.x: I engaged the pianist Pierre Jean-Louis who had worked with me before but it was quite difficult to find a good coloured bass player. The trouble was that the people wanted me to bring an all Negro band. Of course, Guy Lafitte was white, but his dark curly hair and tone of skin could make believe that he had some coloured relative in the family. Casspoil was truly white, but the people insisted to have a majority of coloureds in the band.
I finally met a bassist named Emmanuel Jude whom I had known for a couple of years. I think that Jude was from Martinque as was Pierre Jean Louis.

We did our five concerts and started in the Palais Trischli in St. Gallen the first of February and finished the 28th. We had quite a nice success. That was winter time and we had a lot of snow. It was also carnival time, and that was a big affair for weeks in St. Gallen.
